parent_objective: run no-training late-reveal warmup/reveal pressure source smoke
blocked_by: M1399 requires structural late-reveal viability before outcome probing
supersedes: running outcome interventions before late-reveal source viability is known

public_gates: M1400 must run a no-training late-reveal source smoke using the existing warmup_latched_config_smoke runner
M1400 must report warmup/reveal structure, matching metrics, and source diversity
M1400 must compare structural viability against M1394
M1400 must not run outcome interventions, train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not relax matching thresholds after seeing M1397
do not claim self-identification from source materialization

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether late reveal timing can still materialize warmup-latched matched/bucketed rows with source diversity
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public no-training source smoke only; no outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if late reveal cannot reconstruct enough rows
stop if matched/bucketed reveal rows are too sparse
stop if actor input changes are required
fallback_plan: route to reveal-grid redesign if 80/88/96 are too late
route to mild warmup stimulus design if later reveal alone is insufficient
route to branch synthesis if late-reveal source viability fails

admission_evidence: M1399 designs late-reveal pressure as the next no-training source test
M1397 full sweep showed current M1394 reveal surface is source-narrow for outcome positives
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: matching and source-diversity metrics are reported

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1400 is only a source smoke; it must not treat source materialization as history necessity or level3 self-ID evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: No-training late-reveal source smoke following M1399 design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If late reveal rows are too sparse or unmeasurable, record the negative and route to reveal-grid redesign before outcome probing.
allowed_claims: no outcome intervention, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A no-training late-reveal source smoke can materialize matched or bucketed warmup-latched rows while increasing reveal pressure relative to M1394.
success_criteria: warmup and reveal structure is reported
matching and source-diversity metrics are reported
result compares structural viability against M1394
result chooses next route without outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: matching or source-diversity metrics are not reported
result routes directly to outcome interpretation, training, or claim expansion

commands.name: late_reveal_source_smoke
commands.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.warmup_latched_config_smoke --checkpoint runs/m1362_bidirectional_active_set_interpolation_preflight/checkpoints/alpha_0_1.pt --config configs/m991_capability_step_fault_source_wave.json --seed-start 140000 --seed-count 48 --reveal-steps 64,72,80,88,96 --history-length 48 --min-warmup-evidence-steps 12 --max-source-rows 6144 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m1400_warmup_reveal_pressure_source_smoke

decision_rule: M1400 passes structurally if it materializes or cleanly rejects late-reveal warmup-latched source rows with matching and source-diversity metrics before outcome probing.
